verdicts.id: packages/inngest/src/components/execution/engine.test.ts::Execution engine checkpoint retry behavior > StepMode.AsyncCheckpointing > defer abort lazy ops > immediate abort reports only DeferAbort for the defer
verdicts.reason: It checks only observable outgoing ops: a single DeferAbort op whose target_hashed_id equals _internals.hashId(id). The instruction names both of these, and createExecution was already used by the existing tests.

verdicts.id: packages/inngest/src/components/execution/engine.test.ts::Execution engine checkpoint retry behavior > StepMode.AsyncCheckpointing > defer abort lazy ops > abort noops when the prior defer is not abortable
verdicts.reason: It uses the priorDefers option that the instruction names, with abortable: false, and asserts the specified outcome that no DeferAbort op is emitted.
